name: リンク共有とコピー書き出しの選択
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Actual Lighthouse LH15-0012 only: choose link-sharing or export-copy method. One compact component, pure white canvas, no full screen.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary icon geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment, spacing and small control anatomy. Use only Choose-how-to-share two-option region: selected Link with double-ring radio, globe, SQUARE SAFE/KEY protection glyph (not generic padlock), Modify-settings chevron, unselected Export-copy radio. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese content/locked typography; its solid selected dot and generic lock substitute are inaccurate. Restore original outlined radio plus filled center, and original square safe/key outline with short feet. Image3 approved white material/green-brand style only.
Exact Japanese text:
"共有方法を選択"
"リンクを共有"
"ほかの人は閲覧できます"
"パスワードや有効期限を追加"
"設定を変更 ›"
"コピーを書き出す"
No other text. Meiryo Regular14/24px main label; Bold12/16px option names; Regular12/16px supporting lines and settings link, tracking0. Preserve complete text and line breaks.
Logical width390px. Header, selected link option with title left/radio right; two compact support rows globe and safe glyph; settings link beneath; unselected export option below with hollow circle far right. Preserve original alignment and clear option grouping. A white rounded selected region with fine forest-green outline and small green radio cue, no broad tinted fill. Other surfaces/canvas pure#FFFFFF, subtle neutral edge/soft shadow only as useful, avoid nested repeated cards.
Accent decision: Original blue radio/settings communicate actual selected state and action. Adapt both consistently to forest-green#1F6444; keep utilities slate#526173 and unselected radio neutral. No random colored icons, mint fill, glow or glossy finish. No dominant submit CTA exists inside this component; do not add Copy-link/Share buttons or invite panel from surrounding source.
Original fine details take priority over rough mock. No invented options, controls, metrics, IDs, captions, English, app chrome or watermark. Static candidate.
reviewNotes: 原図と自作を実際に開き、原図のラジオ二重円と四角い金庫／鍵の細部を復元。生成を目視：6件の日本語ラベル・選択リンク／未選択コピーを保持。元の青い選択と設定操作を緑へ統一し白面を維持、自作の広いミント色を除去。ほかの操作・招待・コピーボタン追加なし。厳密な書体メトリクス・所有者承認・編集性・実装未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
